autoMoveCheckInterval.title: Auto Move Check Interval
autoMoveCheckInterval.description: How often to check for new targets (ms)

autoMoveTimeLimit.title: Auto Move Time Limit
autoMoveTimeLimit.description: Time limit for auto-move in seconds (0 = unlimited)

autoMoveDisableOnInput.title: Auto Move Disable On Input
autoMoveDisableOnInput.description: Whether manual input should disable auto-move

swingForce.title: Swing Force
swingForce.description: Force applied by player input during swing

swingGravityScale.title: Swing Gravity Scale
swingGravityScale.description: Multiplier on gravity during swing (>1 = heavier swings)

swingDamping.title: Swing Damping
swingDamping.description: Velocity damping per frame during swing (0.95-1.0)

swingJumpBoost.title: Swing Jump Boost
swingJumpBoost.description: Multiplier on jump force when jumping off swing

swingRopeStiffness.title: Swing Rope Stiffness
swingRopeStiffness.description: Spring constant for rope tension (higher = tighter rope)

swingVelCancelStrength.title: Swing Vel Cancel Strength
swingVelCancelStrength.description: How aggressively outward velocity is cancelled at rope limit (lower = bouncier, higher = stiffer). Was hardcoded at 10

useVelocityMovement.description: Set linearVelocity instead of teleport for normal movement. Requires Dynamic rigidbody with gravity enabled. Climb/flight/swing still teleport.

velocityStopRate.description: How fast X/Z velocity damps to zero when input is released (higher = snappier stop, less slide). Y is left alone so gravity is unaffected. Only used when useVelocityMovement is on.

cameraLockedRotation.description: Player rotation follows camera yaw every frame (3rd-person-shooter feel). When on, movement-direction rotation is bypassed — joystick still moves the player, but they always face camera forward.

cameraDistanceMax.description: Maximum Camera Distance players can control

specificCameraDistanceMax.description: Maximum Camera Distance that can be set by event call

presetsConfig.title: Camera Presets Config
presetsConfig.description: JSON asset defining camera presets (sparse objects with yAngleMin, yAngleMax, zoom, etc.)

buildVersion.title: Build Version
buildVersion.description: Analytics build/version string passed to gameAnalytics (e.g. v32). Bump per export, else GA version-splitting is moot.

checkpointId.title: Checkpoint Identifier (optional)
checkpointId.description: Can be a number (as a string) for progression levels or a custom name for linear levels.

cameraAngles.title: Camera Angles
cameraAngles.description: Custom camera angles as an array [x, y, z].

updateCameraAngles.title: Update Camera Angles
updateCameraAngles.description: If checked, the custom cameraAngles will update the camera when the checkpoint is activated.

saveOnTouch.title: Save On Touch
saveOnTouch.description: If unchecked, walking over this checkpoint will not update the saved spawn point.

dynamicCameraAngles.title: Game-Computed Camera Angles
dynamicCameraAngles.description: After arrival, take the camera angles from a game-registered resolver (app.api.checkpoints.setCameraAngleResolver) instead of the static Camera Angles. Falls back to the authored Camera Angles if no resolver / it returns null.

baseEntity.title: Base Entity
baseEntity.description: Image Element Entity that shows the base of the joystick.

nubEntity.title: Nub Entity
nubEntity.description: Image Element Entity that shows the nub (top) of the joystick.

order: Move to first touch and fixed
Move to first touch and drags

type.title: Type
type.description: Set type of behavior for the joystick.

hideOnRelease.title: Hide on Release
hideOnRelease.description: Will only show the joystick when the user is using it and will hide it on touch end. This is commonly used if you don't want the joystick to block what's being shown on screen.

identifier.title: Identifier
identifier.description: A unique name for the joystick to refer to it by in the API. Joysticks are also buttons so this will also be the name of button in the API. It will give a warning in browser tools if the name is not unique.

axisDeadZone.title: Axis Dead Zone
axisDeadZone.description: The number of UI units from the position of the Base Entity where input is not registered.

axisRange.title: Axis Range
axisRange.description: The number of UI units from the position of the Base Entity that the Nub Entity can move to and is the maximum range

positionOnRelease.title: Position on Release
positionOnRelease.description: Where to move the joystick on release and can help keep the screen tidy so that there are clear areas to show the game and arrange controls.

vibrationPress.title: Vibration duration (ms)
vibrationPress.description: If the device supports vibration with 'Navigator.vibrate', it will vibrate for the duration set here on touch down.Set to 0 to disable.

sensitivity.title: Sensitivity
sensitivity.description: Adjusts the sensitivity of the joystick. Higher values make the joystick more responsive.

controlMode.title: Control Mode
controlMode.description: Toggle between gradual axis values based on distance from center and a constant power value.

constantPower.title: Constant Power
constantPower.description: The constant power value to use when control mode is set to constant.

identifier.title: Identifier
identifier.description: A unique name for the button to refer to it by in the API. Will give a warning in browser tools if the name is not unique.

vibration.title: Vibration duration (ms)
vibration.description: If the device supports vibration with 'Navigator.vibrate', it will vibrate for the duration set here on touch down.Set to 0 to disable.

xRotationAxisPoint.title: Rotation Axis Point for X Axis

yRotationAxisPoint.title: Rotation Axis Point for Y Axis

zRotationAxisPoint.title: Rotation Axis Point for Z Axis

elementTags.description: Render to elements that have these tags

textEntity.title: Text Entity
textEntity.description: The Entity that has the text Element to update with the inputted text.

placeHolder.title: Place Holder String
placeHolder.description: When the inputted text is empty, what should show as placeholder? Usually this is a prompt such as 'Enter your email here'.

maxLength.title: Max Length
maxLength.description: Maximum length of the text can be.

inputType.title: Input Type
inputType.description: What type of input will this field accept. On some devices, the virtual keyboard layout may change as well. For example, 'Number' will bring up a numpad instead of the full keyboard.

placeHolderColor.title: Place Holder Text Color
placeHolderColor.description: What color the text should be when the placeholder string is used.

enterKeyHint.title: Enter Key Hint
enterKeyHint.description: Change what the enter key shows on the virutal keyboard. Different OSs will have different representations of the hint.

schema.name: sceneName
schema.title: Scene Name
schema.description: Scene/world that uses obby-style level progression.

schema.name: maxLevel
schema.title: Max Level
schema.description: Highest level id in this scene (used for completeRun + the skipLevelMenu/playing play-state gate).

progressionScenes.title: Progression Scenes
progressionScenes.description: Legacy obby-style progression (concern #3): Level_X analytics, gameTimer, skip-level menu. Independent of Scene Spawns — a scene must be in computed Scene Spawns OR here, never both.

firstTimeScene.title: First Time Scene
firstTimeScene.description: Boot routing (concern #1): the world loaded for a brand-new player (no hasPlayedBefore save). Also gates the first-run tutorial path.

returningScene.title: Returning Scene
returningScene.description: Boot routing (concern #1): FALLBACK world for a returning player when there is no valid lastVisitedMainWorld (their last world is not in Main Worlds).

mainWorlds.title: Main Worlds
mainWorlds.description: Boot routing (concern #1): whitelist of "resumable" worlds. A returning player boots into their lastVisitedMainWorld ONLY if it is in this list (else Returning Scene). sceneManager writes lastVisitedMainWorld whenever a loaded scene is in this list. Leave a scene OUT to prevent rejoin-into-it.

schema.name: scene
schema.title: Scene Name
schema.description: Scene/world this rule applies to. Must match the name sceneManager loads (e.g. "World").

schema.name: mode
schema.title: Spawn Mode
schema.description: computed = game-supplied resolver via setSpawnResolver (recomputed live, NEVER saved — e.g. plot/pen). checkpoint = saved currentCheckpoint<scene> -> registered marker entity. spawnPoint = always the isSpawn-tagged marker; nothing saved.

sceneSpawns.title: Scene Spawns
sceneSpawns.description: Spawn resolution (concern #2): per-scene spawn mode. A scene NOT listed resolves checkpoint-style by default. Do NOT also list a computed scene in Progression Scenes.

encryptionEnabled.title: Encryption Enabled
encryptionEnabled.description: Enable or disable encryption when saving and loading data

sceneName.title: Scene Name
sceneName.description: The name of the current scene root.

preventOverlap.title: Prevent Overlap
preventOverlap.description: List of entity names to check for overlap.

noRotation.title: No Rotation
noRotation.description: List of entity names that should stay at original rotation position.

customRotationSpeeds.title: Custom Rotation Speeds
customRotationSpeeds.description: Set custom rotation speed multipliers for specific entities.

centerEntity.title: Center Entity
centerEntity.description: The entity around which other entities will be placed.

faceRotationDirection.title: Face Rotation Direction
faceRotationDirection.description: List of entity names that should face rotation direction instead of center

ignoreInCenterCircle.title: Ignore in Center Circle
ignoreInCenterCircle.description: Do not add to center circle

customScaleFactors.title: Custom Scale Factors
customScaleFactors.description: Optional scale multipliers for specific entities. The base scaleFactor will be multiplied by this value.

extraYaw.title: Extra Y‑aw Offsets
extraYaw.description: Per‑entity yaw adjustments to apply after facing direction.

rotationSpeed.title: Rotation Speed
rotationSpeed.description: Speed at which the entity rotates (degrees per second)

ignoreDistance.title: Ignore Distance
ignoreDistance.description: If true, the entity will rotate at full speed regardless of the distance to the player

rotationThreshold.title: Rotation Threshold
rotationThreshold.description: Custom rotation threshold for this entity. If null, the default threshold in RotationManager will be used.

impulseForce.title: Impulse Force
impulseForce.description: Forch with which objects are pushed

impulseByVector.title: Impulse direction by Vector
impulseByVector.description: Force direction by vector switch. use for manipulating force direction with limited volume scope but free direction

impulseByLocalAxis.title: Impulse direction by Axis
impulseByLocalAxis.description: Force direction by local object Axis. use for manipulating force by adjusting object rotation itself

impulseByContact.title: Impulse direction by Vector
impulseByContact.description: Force direction by vector switch. use for manipulating force direction with limited volume scope but free direction

temporaryLinearDampingChange.title: Temporary linear damping value
temporaryLinearDampingChange.description: Temporary linear damping value. -1 for no change, 0~1 for setting value

temporaryLinearDampingDuration.title: Temporary linear damping change duration
temporaryLinearDampingDuration.description: Temporary linear damping change duration. 0 for no duration, positive integer for duration in ms

soundName.title: Soundslot name
soundName.description: Sound slot name in string to trigger for player sound. Can be null/nullstring to not trigger a player sound. Also can be different per forceImpulse entity

rotationSpeed.title: Rotation Speed
rotationSpeed.description: Speed at which the entity rotates (degrees per second)

checkpointId.title: Checkpoint ID
checkpointId.description: ID or name of the checkpoint to load.

checkFunction.title: Conditional Check Function
checkFunction.description: Global function name to call to decide if teleport should work.

difficultySuffix.title: Difficulty Suffix
difficultySuffix.description: Dungeon difficulty suffix (easy/medium/hard). Appends to scene name for matchmaking.

maxVertices.title: Max Vertices
maxVertices.description: Maximum number of trail vertices (higher = longer trail, lower performance)

sortOrder.title: Sort Order
sortOrder.description: Choose ascending or descending ranking order

concealRankWhenBeyondMax.title: Conceal Rank When Beyond Max Entries

bigTimeStatFontScale.title: Big Time Stat Font Scale
bigTimeStatFontScale.description: Font size multiplier for big time stats (e.g., 0.8 for 80% size)

useGlobalLeaderboard.title: Use Global Leaderboard
useGlobalLeaderboard.description: If true, queries persistent global leaderboard from server instead of lobby players

globalRefreshInterval.title: Global Refresh Interval (seconds)
globalRefreshInterval.description: How often to refresh global leaderboard data

abbreviateLargeNumbers.title: Abbreviate Large Numbers
abbreviateLargeNumbers.description: If true, formats large numbers with K, M, B, T, Qa, etc. suffixes

schema.description: Type identifier (e.g., gem, coin, food, money)

schema.description: Template entity for this resource type. Should contain Icon and Text child entities.

schema.description: Number of pre-allocated entities for this resource type

schema.description: UI element where this resource should move to (e.g., gem counter, money display)

schema.description: Default texture for this resource icon

schema.name: animationDuration

schema.description: Duration of animation for this resource type

schema.name: spawnRadius

schema.description: Random spawn radius for this resource

schema.name: arcHeight

schema.description: Height of animation arc for this resource

schema.name: enableRotation

schema.description: Whether this resource rotates during animation

schema.name: soundEffect

schema.description: Sound to play when collecting this resource

resourceConfigs.title: Resource Configurations
resourceConfigs.description: Array of configurations for different resource types

maxConcurrentAnimations.title: Max Concurrent Animations
maxConcurrentAnimations.description: Maximum total animations that can play simultaneously across all resource types

poolEntityOverride.title: Pool Group Entity Override
poolEntityOverride.description: Parent entity for animation pool. If not set, will use "Ingame Screen"

camera.title: Camera
camera.description: The camera used for world to screen conversion

damageTextDuration.title: Duration
damageTextDuration.description: How long damage text is visible (seconds)

floatSpeed.title: Float Speed
floatSpeed.description: Speed at which damage text rises (pixels per second)

enableScaleAnimation.title: Enable Scale Animation
enableScaleAnimation.description: Animate scale on spawn for impact

fadeStartPercent.title: Fade Start
fadeStartPercent.description: When to start fading (0-1, where 1 is end of duration)

fontAsset.title: Font Asset
fontAsset.description: Font for damage text (optional, uses default if not set)

heightOffset.title: Height Offset
heightOffset.description: How high above the target to show damage (world units)

screenGroup.title: Screen Group
screenGroup.description: Parent entity containing the screen elements

modelGroup.title: Model Group
modelGroup.description: Parent entity under which 3D models will be placed

modelSourceGroup.title: Model Source Group
modelSourceGroup.description: Default entity containing model templates to clone from

rewardModelScreen2D.title: 2D Reward Model Screen
rewardModelScreen2D.description: Screen entity containing 2D elements to update via screenData

rewardHighlighter.title: Reward Highlighter
rewardHighlighter.description: Entity with element component to apply highlight color to

rarityColors.title: Rarity Colors
rarityColors.description: Expandable array of rarity names and their colors (RGB 0-255)

displayEntityGroupName.title: Display Entity Group Name
displayEntityGroupName.description: Name of the parent entity containing display options

displayEntityLocalPosition.title: Display Entity Local Position
displayEntityLocalPosition.description: Local position for the display entity sprite

displayEntityLocalScale.title: Display Entity Local Scale
displayEntityLocalScale.description: Local scale for the display entity sprite (0 = use original scale for that axis)

displayEntityName.title: Display Entity Name
displayEntityName.description: Name of the entity to clone from the display group

isDisplayEntityScreen.title: Is Display Entity Screen
isDisplayEntityScreen.description: Whether the display entity is a screen that can show dynamic data from config

displayEntityProximityOnly.title: Display Entity Proximity Only
displayEntityProximityOnly.description: If true, main display entity only shows when player is in proximity

autoSelectDisplayEntity.title: Auto Select Display Entity
autoSelectDisplayEntity.description: Randomly select display entity from autoSelectDisplayEntityList

autoSelectDisplayEntityList.title: Auto Select Display Entity List
autoSelectDisplayEntityList.description: List of display entity names to randomly select from

rewardId.title: Reward ID
rewardId.description: ID to lookup in the reward config JSON

cullingDistance.title: Culling Distance
cullingDistance.description: Distance at which the display entity is culled (disabled)

screenScaleWithZoom.title: Screen Scale With Zoom
screenScaleWithZoom.description: Grow the world-space reward screen as the camera pulls back, so it stays readable when zoomed out.

screenScaleRefDistance.title: Screen Scale Ref Distance
screenScaleRefDistance.description: Camera-to-kiosk distance at which the screen keeps its authored size. Beyond this it grows; never shrinks below authored.

screenScaleStrength.title: Screen Scale Strength
screenScaleStrength.description: 0 = no zoom compensation, 1 = full constant-apparent-size. ~0.7 grows it noticeably without ballooning.

screenScaleMax.title: Screen Scale Max
screenScaleMax.description: Upper clamp on the zoom-scale multiplier (prevents over-large screens at max zoom-out).

collisionPercentageToTrigger.title: Collision Percentage To Trigger
collisionPercentageToTrigger.description: Distance at which the interaction prompt is sent

eventTag.title: Event Tag
eventTag.description: Tag for API events (e.g. "speedUpgrade"). Leave empty to disable API events

isOneTimePurchase.title: Is One-Time Purchase
isOneTimePurchase.description: Whether this item can only be purchased once (permanent upgrade)

useCssPrompt.title: Use CSS Prompt
useCssPrompt.description: Show a compact CSS pill prompt on proximity instead of the 3D sign. Pill has an E key badge + configurable message; tap or press E to interact.

cssPromptMessage.title: CSS Prompt Message
cssPromptMessage.description: Text shown on the proximity prompt (e.g. "Open Shop", "Buy", "Interact").

cssPromptWorldOffset.title: CSS Prompt World Offset
cssPromptWorldOffset.description: Local offset above the trigger entity where the prompt is anchored.

useCssPromptAd.title: Use CSS Prompt (Ad / Q)
useCssPromptAd.description: Adds a second pill below the E pill with a Q key badge for the ad-watch path. Tap or press Q fires the registeredKeys.Q msgType (e.g. "buyAd"). Requires Use CSS Prompt to be on.

cssPromptAdMessage.title: CSS Prompt Ad Message
cssPromptAdMessage.description: Text shown on the second (Q / ad) pill.

purchasedDisplayEntityName.title: Purchased Display Entity Name
purchasedDisplayEntityName.description: Entity to display when item is already purchased (from same display group)

schema.name: enabled
schema.description: Enable to teleport player away after purchase, insufficient currency, or on cooldown

schema.name: checkpointName
schema.description: Checkpoint name to teleport player to

schema.name: skipTeleportIfCantAfford
schema.description: If true, player will NOT be teleported when they lack currency (only teleports on successful purchase)

proximityMode.title: Proximity Mode
proximityMode.description: none=always visible, standalone=toggle on enter/leave, global=only closest shop shows

interactionMode.title: Interaction Mode
interactionMode.description: walkIn=proximity triggers action, button=requires explicit key/button press

triggerMode.title: Trigger Mode
triggerMode.description: fill=highlighter scales to 100% before firing, immediate=fires instantly

highlighterMaxScale.title: Highlighter Max Scale
highlighterMaxScale.description: Maximum scale of the highlighter ring (X/Z axes). Default 7.5 for reward shops, use 5 for permanent upgrades.

sigDigits.title: Significant Digits
sigDigits.description: Number of decimal places for K/M/B formatting (0=disabled, 1=1K, 2=1.2K, 3=1.23K, 4=1.234K). Set to 0 to show full numbers.

pointerUnlockByProximity.title: Pointer Unlock By Proximity
pointerUnlockByProximity.description: If true, disables pointer lock when player enters proximity

pointerLockOnLeave.title: Pointer Lock On Leave
pointerLockOnLeave.description: If true (and pointerUnlockByProximity is true), re-enables pointer lock when player leaves proximity

screenEntities.title: Screen Entities
screenEntities.description: List of additional screen entity configurations to update with shop data

schema.name: groupName
schema.description: Group to find screen entity in (defaults to displayEntityGroupName)

schema.name: entityName
schema.description: Name of screen entity within the group

schema.name: tags
schema.description: Optional TemplatePool group tag (tp:*) to INSTANTIATE this screen entity from (e.g. "tp:items"). Empty = clone it from the scene group (legacy).

schema.name: posX
schema.description: X position relative to interactionTrigger

schema.name: posY
schema.description: Y position relative to interactionTrigger

schema.name: posZ
schema.description: Z position relative to interactionTrigger

schema.name: proximityOnly
schema.description: If true, only visible when player is in proximity

schema.name: hasStock
schema.description: If true, shop has limited stock that depletes on purchase and restocks after cooldown

schema.name: maxStock
schema.description: Maximum stock when fully restocked

schema.name: restockCooldown
schema.description: Time until shop restocks after selling out (default 3 hours = 10800)

purchaseCooldown.title: Purchase Cooldown (ms)
purchaseCooldown.description: Global cooldown after purchase to prevent re-triggering (default 4500ms)

displayEntityLocalEuler.title: Display Entity Local Euler
displayEntityLocalEuler.description: STATIC rotation (degrees) applied to the mounted display model in the KIOSK's frame, on top of the model's authored pose — use it to FACE a display whose baked orientation doesn't match the kiosk (e.g. turn a wheel face toward the player approach). Distinct from Display Entity X/Y/Z Rotation, which are CONTINUOUS rotation speeds driven by the rotation manager.

displayTags.title: Display Template Tag (tp:*)
displayTags.description: TemplatePool group tag the display model is INSTANTIATED from via app.api.templates (e.g. "tp:items" or "items"; the "tp:" prefix is optional). When set, displayEntityName is resolved as a template carrying this tag instead of being cloned from a scene entity group — so a kiosk can show any template kind. Empty = ask the game shop-resolver to map Display Entity Group Name to a tp:* group, else clone from the scene group (legacy fallback).

domScreenScaleRefDistance.title: DOM Card Scale Ref Distance
domScreenScaleRefDistance.description: Camera-to-kiosk distance at which the DOM reward card renders at 1x. Closer than this = larger (up to Max), farther = smaller (down to Min).

domScreenScaleMin.title: DOM Card Scale Min
domScreenScaleMin.description: Lower clamp on the DOM card distance scale. Lower = far kiosks shrink more (stronger "this is far away" depth cue). The card tracks true perspective (ref/distance) until it hits this floor.

domScreenScaleMax.title: DOM Card Scale Max
domScreenScaleMax.description: Upper clamp on the DOM card distance scale (prevents the card dominating the screen up close).

domScreenMaxDistance.title: DOM Card Max Distance
domScreenMaxDistance.description: Beyond this camera-to-kiosk distance the DOM reward card is hidden entirely (and skips its per-frame positioning work — a perf win, not a cost). 0 = never distance-hide.

domScreenScaleWithViewport.title: DOM Card Scale With Viewport
domScreenScaleWithViewport.description: Also scale the DOM card by the canvas size vs a 1280x720 design reference, so on a small window it shrinks with the rest of the UI (the kit panels use vw/vmin) instead of staying a fixed pixel size. Capped at 1x (authored size) on large windows; floored so it stays readable on tiny ones.

domScreenMobileScale.title: DOM Card Mobile Scale
domScreenMobileScale.description: Multiplier applied to the DOM card scale on MOBILE (a phone screen is the whole viewport + needs bigger, tap-friendly UI). 1 = same as desktop authored size; >1 = larger. Replaces the desktop window-shrink on mobile.

displayEntityFaceTag.title: Display Entity Face Tag
displayEntityFaceTag.description: Aim the mounted display model at the NEAREST entity carrying this tag (a level-design marker — drop an empty tagged entity where the display should face; horizontal yaw only, the model stays upright). Applied ON TOP of Display Entity Local Euler. CONVENTION: the display's front is the kiosk's local +Z after Local Euler — pre-correct a rig whose painted face differs using Local Euler. Empty = no aiming.

enablePokiTracking.title: Enable Poki SDK Tracking
enablePokiTracking.description: Forward analytics events to Poki SDK

enableDebugLogging.title: Enable Debug Logging
enableDebugLogging.description: Log all Poki SDK events to console

deduplicationWindow.title: Deduplication Window (ms)
deduplicationWindow.description: Prevent duplicate events within this time window

playerEntity.title: Player Entity
playerEntity.description: The player entity (beam starts near player)

fadeNearDistance.title: Fade Near Distance
fadeNearDistance.description: Distance from player where beam starts fading

minTargetDistance.title: Min Target Distance
minTargetDistance.description: Hide beam if target is closer than this

segments.title: Beam Segments
segments.description: Quality of beam curve (higher = smoother). Increase for longer beams.

updateFrequency.title: Update Frequency
updateFrequency.description: 0 = every frame, N = every Nth frame

patternDensity.title: Pattern Density
patternDensity.description: Chevrons per unit distance (auto-scales with beam length)

listenEntityName.title: Listen Entity Name
listenEntityName.description: Entity name to listen for trackDirection events (leave empty to use this entity name). Set to "ObjectiveArrow" for gameplay.js compatibility.

camera.title: Camera
camera.description: The camera entity to capture blur from

iterations.title: Iterations
iterations.description: Number of blur iterations. Higher number means better quality but worse performance. Keep it low on mobile devices.

radiusFactor.title: Radius Factor
radiusFactor.description: Blur radius factor. Higher number means more blur.

spinDuration.title: Spin Duration
spinDuration.description: How long the spin animation lasts in seconds

minFullSpins.title: Min Full Spins
minFullSpins.description: Minimum number of full rotations before landing

maxFullSpins.title: Max Full Spins
maxFullSpins.description: Maximum number of full rotations before landing

rotationAxis.title: Rotation Axis
rotationAxis.description: Which axis the wheel spins on

wheelPartName.title: Wheel Part Name
wheelPartName.description: Name of the wheel entity to find in the cloned model

maxOtherPlayerBursts.title: Max Other Player Bursts
maxOtherPlayerBursts.description: Maximum concurrent burst effects from other players (0 to disable)

otherPlayerCooldown.title: Other Player Cooldown
otherPlayerCooldown.description: Minimum time (seconds) between other player effects

enableFlash.title: Enable Flash
enableFlash.description: Enable impact flash effect (adds draw calls)

enableSparks.title: Enable Sparks
enableSparks.description: Enable spark particles (adds draw calls and material updates)

otherPlayerSimpleEffects.title: Other Player Simple Effects
otherPlayerSimpleEffects.description: Force other players to use default shader (reduces GPU cost)

otherPlayerUpdateSkip.title: Other Player Update Skip
otherPlayerUpdateSkip.description: Update other player effects every N frames (1=every frame, 2=half rate, etc.)

ownPlayerUpdateSkip.title: Own Player Update Skip
ownPlayerUpdateSkip.description: Update own player effects every N frames (1=every frame, 2=half rate)

enemyScaleInfluence.title: Enemy Scale Influence
enemyScaleInfluence.description: How much enemy size affects burst scale (0=none, 1=full)

otherPlayerViewportCulling.title: Viewport Culling
otherPlayerViewportCulling.description: Skip other player effects that are outside camera view

otherPlayerDistancePriority.title: Distance Priority
otherPlayerDistancePriority.description: When at burst limit, prioritize closer effects over distant ones

lineCount.title: Line Count
lineCount.description: Number of swirling lines around the entity

radius.title: Radius
radius.description: Radius of the vortex around the entity

spinSpeed.title: Spin Speed
spinSpeed.description: How fast lines orbit around the entity

riseSpeed.title: Rise Speed
riseSpeed.description: How fast lines rise upward (0 = no rise)

wobble.title: Wobble
wobble.description: Random wobble in the spiral motion

enableFPSMonitoring.title: Enable FPS Monitoring
enableFPSMonitoring.description: Monitor FPS and auto-adjust quality for struggling devices

fpsMonitorDuration.title: FPS Monitor Window (seconds)
fpsMonitorDuration.description: Length of the rolling window before a tier decision (struggling devices re-check faster)

fpsLowThreshold.title: Low FPS Threshold
fpsLowThreshold.description: Downgrade quality if median FPS drops below this

fpsHighThreshold.title: High FPS Threshold
fpsHighThreshold.description: Upgrade quality if median FPS stays above this

highSettings.title: High Quality Settings
highSettings.description: For high-end devices (flagships, gaming PCs, modern desktops)

mediumSettings.title: Medium Quality Settings
mediumSettings.description: For mid-range devices (2019-2021 phones, average laptops)

lowSettings.title: Low Quality Settings
lowSettings.description: For low-end devices (budget phones, old PCs, Chromebooks)

debug.title: Debug Logging
debug.description: Log device/GPU detection, tier changes and FPS analysis to the console

debugEnabled.title: Debug Mode
debugEnabled.description: Enable to simulate safe area insets for testing

debugTop.title: Debug Top Inset
debugTop.description: Simulated top safe area in pixels

debugBottom.title: Debug Bottom Inset
debugBottom.description: Simulated bottom safe area in pixels

debugLeft.title: Debug Left Inset
debugLeft.description: Simulated left safe area in pixels (for landscape testing)

debugRight.title: Debug Right Inset
debugRight.description: Simulated right safe area in pixels (for landscape testing)

rectangleShape.title: Rectangle Shape
rectangleShape.description: Use rectangle shape instead of circular

maxRange.title: Max Lasso Range
maxRange.description: Maximum raycast distance for a lasso throw

defaultSwingLength.title: Default Swing Length
defaultSwingLength.description: Target pendulum rope length during swing. Adjustable via to:lasso:setSwingLength event

anchorTag.title: Anchor Tag
anchorTag.description: Only entities with this tag can be grappled

anchorLayerFallback.title: Allow Static Geometry
anchorLayerFallback.description: If true, static rigidbodies can be anchored even without the tag

ropeExtendSpeed.title: Rope Extend Speed
ropeExtendSpeed.description: Units per second for the extending animation

loopRadius.title: Loop Radius
loopRadius.description: Radius of the lasso loop at the tip

beamColor.title: Beam Color
beamColor.description: Color of the extend beam glow effect

lassoStyle.title: Lasso Style
lassoStyle.description: Visual style preset. Reads from LassoStyleConfig.

throwArcHeight.title: Throw Arc Height
throwArcHeight.description: Peak height of throw arc. Scales with distance. 0 = straight line (laser).

chargeSpinSpeed.title: Charge Spin Speed
chargeSpinSpeed.description: Revolutions per second of the loop during charge wind-up

chargeLoopHeight.title: Charge Loop Height
chargeLoopHeight.description: Height above player where the loop spins during charging

chargeRopeLength.title: Charge Rope Length
chargeRopeLength.description: Length of rope from hand to spinning loop during charging

chargeDuration.title: Charge Duration
chargeDuration.description: Seconds of wind-up before auto-firing when fired from idle

sourcePoint.title: Source Point
sourcePoint.description: Optional entity for rope/beam origin. Falls back to player shoulder if not set.

holdPoint.title: Hold Point
holdPoint.description: Optional entity where lasso is held. Falls back to sourcePoint + chargeLoopHeight if not set.

holdPointOrder.title: Hold Point Order
holdPointOrder.description: Per-state ordered list of hold points. Order determines waypoint sequence (first = closest to source).

schema.name: order
schema.title: Order
schema.description: Comma-separated hold point keys in order, e.g. "holdPoint,holdPoint2"

detectionRadius.title: Detection Radius
detectionRadius.description: Radius of detection cone at max range / cylinder constant radius. Ignored for sphere shape

detectionShape.title: Detection Shape
detectionShape.description: Cone widens with distance; cylinder uses constant radius; sphere uses range as radius (omnidirectional)

detectionTags.title: Detection Tags
detectionTags.description: Comma-separated list of entity tags. Entity must have ANY of these to qualify

detectionMode.title: Detection Mode
detectionMode.description: Spatial: findByTag + distance math (no rigidbodies needed). Raycast: physics raycastAll (needs rigidbodies)

detectionOriginSource.title: Detection Origin Source
detectionOriginSource.description: Where detection originates from. Player: playerEntity + offset. Camera: cameraEntity position

detectionOriginOffset.title: Detection Origin Offset
detectionOriginOffset.description: Offset from origin source position (e.g. shoulder height for player)

mainTargetCondition.title: Main Target Condition
mainTargetCondition.description: How main target is selected from detected targets

targetDisplayOption.title: Target Display Option
targetDisplayOption.description: single: main only. focusedMulti: all targets, main styled differently. multi: all same style. none: no visuals

maxTargets.title: Max Targets
maxTargets.description: Maximum number of targets to track (indicator pool size)

stickyTarget.title: Sticky Target
stickyTarget.description: Keep current main target if still valid (prevents flicker between close targets)

guideBeamWidth.title: Guide Beam Width
guideBeamWidth.description: Width of the ribbon in world units

debugCheckKey.title: Debug Check Key
debugCheckKey.description: Key to trigger detection check (dev environments only)

gameMode.title: Game mode
gameMode.description: Sets app.currentGameMode. Use a unique id per game. Engine code is game-agnostic; only game-layer code may branch on this.

demoWorld.title: Demo world / scene to load
demoWorld.description: Scene the hub boots — set on app.startScene; the engine checkpointManager loads it, OVERRIDING its own firstTimeScene/mainWorlds routing (the HUB owns which scene loads, not the editor). Defaults to "Demo". Leave BLANK to fall back to checkpointManager's editor attributes.

neutralizeGameRegistries.title: Neutralize other games' registries
neutralizeGameRegistries.description: FALLBACK use: replace the active game's per-frame input dispatcher (window.__kimchiGsmCustom) with a no-op so a sibling game's dispatcher does not run without its gameplay. Turn OFF for a real new game (which ships its own gameStateInput_<game>.js).

rebirthTier.title: Rebirth Tier
rebirthTier.description: Which rebirth tier this zone provides (1-4)

requiredLevel.title: Required Level
requiredLevel.description: Minimum level required to use this rebirth zone

camera.title: Camera
camera.description: The camera entity to use for world-to-screen conversion

screenEntity.title: Screen Entity
screenEntity.description: The 2D screen entity for UI elements

showNames.title: Show Names
showNames.description: Show resource names above health bars

healthBarHeight.title: Health Bar Height
healthBarHeight.description: Height of the health bar in pixels

healthBarWidth.title: Health Bar Width
healthBarWidth.description: Width of the health bar in pixels

heightOffset.title: Height Offset
heightOffset.description: How high above the resource to show the UI

fadeDistance.title: Fade Distance
fadeDistance.description: Distance at which UI starts to fade

schema.name: skinName
schema.title: Skin Set Name
schema.description: skin skeleton reference name, used to search through assets for animation. Child entity of player or other player should be named to match capitalized skinName

schema.name: skinIndex
schema.title: skin index/key
schema.description: skin index per skin. some games can use specific numbering rules instead of array index. ignored if custom skin index attribute is disabled

schema.name: skinPrice
schema.title: skin price
schema.description: usually 0~3 equivalent to free, small, medium and large ads

schema.name: parts
schema.title: Skin parts for this skin
schema.description: Number of skin parts, 0 for none

schema.name: typeName
schema.title: Mesh type name
schema.description: skin mesh type name. Name for render mesh of particular skins name

useUnlockSystem.title: unlock system enable
useUnlockSystem.description: Enable skin unlock system. False will disable unlock system, but still save current skin
